maya: Quick note — after rotating creds, dev proxy path returns 401 while direct API calls are fine. Short repro below.

 diego: which SDK? and sample app?

 maya: js 1.15.0 + sample-app/node. Proxy injects X-Local-Auth and drops X-Project-Id.

 frank: SDK parsing order should be constructor > env > X-Project-Id header > X-Local-Auth. If not, parity bug.

 maya: repro:
``
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk.rot.2026
export REDWOOD_PROJECT=infra
node sample-app/server.js --proxy
curl http://localhost:3000/run
```
proxy log: `X-Local-Auth: project=infra;key=rotated` (no X-Project-Id)

 ops-bot: CI: smoke-tests queued for auth-fix branch.

 diego: proposed fixes: (1) sample-app: always send X-Project-Id when proxy enabled, (2) sdk-js: prefer explicit env/constructor before parsing proxy header, (3) non-fatal dev warning when parsing fails behind REDWOOD_DEV_STRICT=0.

 maya: I'll open a small PR with tests for missing headers and rotated keys, plus a docs blurb for onboarding.

 frank: also add a short migration note that REDWOOD_ORG vs REDWOOD_TEAM confusion exists; standardize to REDWOOD_ORG + REDWOOD_PROJECT.

 maya: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1240 (draft)

 diego: thanks — let's run cross-language smoke after merge.
